The U.S. kills three Iranian pilots. As fear escalates, will BTC $77,864.97 hold up first—or kneel first?

The U.S. kills three Iranian pilots; the conflict escalates. Fear spills over into the crypto market, a short-term negative.

Iran’s Tasnim News Agency confirmed that the U.S. airstrike resulted in the deaths of three Iranian pilots. The key point here isn’t the number of casualties—it’s that the nature of the conflict has changed: directly striking the other side’s military personnel, essentially moving the conflict from “verbal warnings from afar” to “real guns, real bullets.” What markets fear most is this kind of uncertainty escalating. Iran has already signaled retaliation. Next, airspace security, oil prices, and risk assets will all need to be repriced.

Market impact
The transmission path is straightforward: geopolitical conflict escalates → global risk assets are sold off → liquidity in the crypto market shrinks → BTC faces pressure. BTC is currently $77,864.97 (down 1.66% in 24h), ETH $2,400.87 (down 1.15%). The price action has already priced in part of this move.

- Short term: Safe-haven funds flow into gold and U.S. Treasuries. In the crypto market—high-volatility assets—positions get cut first. If Iran officially announces retaliation, BTC will likely test the downside again; support around the $76K area will be crucial.
- Medium term: If the conflict keeps intensifying, the pace of ETF inflows may slow down—that would be the real source of pressure. Spot ETF buying is the most important incremental pricing factor for BTC this year.

My view
I’m bearish in the short term; within the next 12 hours, the probability that BTC faces pressure is high. The logic is simple: retaliation hasn’t landed yet, and uncertainty is the biggest negative. Funds will run first, out of caution. But I’ll keep some room—geopolitical selloffs in crypto are historically pulse-like. If Iran’s response is restrained, BTC dropping to around $76K could also be quickly reclaimed. If I’m wrong, go easy on me—I’d only hedge with a small position. Betting direction with a heavy position in this kind of market is basically giving away money.

One-sentence translation: Once the shots are fired, don’t talk about catching the dip—watch how Iran responds first.

- Direction: Negative 📉 Predicted to fall
- Duration: BTC 12 hours / ETH 24 hours

伊朗塔斯尼姆通讯社确认，美军空袭造成三名伊朗飞行员死亡。这事的关键不是伤亡数字本身，而是性质变了：直接打击对方军事人员，基本等于把冲突从“隔空喊话”推到“真刀真枪”阶段。市场最怕的就是这种不确定性升级——伊朗官方已经放出报复风声，接下来空域安全、油价、风险资产全线都要重新定价。

对市场的影响
传导路径很直接：地缘冲突升级 → 全球风险资产遭抛售 → 加密市场流动性收缩 → BTC承压。BTC现在是$77,864.97（24h跌1.66%），ETH $2,400.87（跌1.15%），盘面已经提前反应了一部分。

- 短期：避险资金涌向黄金和美债，币圈这种高波动资产最先被砍仓位。如果伊朗官宣报复，BTC大概率要再探一轮下沿，$76K附近的支撑会很关键。
- 中期：如果冲突持续发酵，ETF资金流入节奏可能放缓，那才是真正的压力来源，现货ETF买盘是今年BTC最重要的边际定价方。

我的判断
我短期看空，12小时内BTC承压概率大。逻辑很简单：报复还没落地，不确定性就是最大的利空，资金会先跑为敬。但我留三分余地——地缘冲突对币圈的砸盘历来是脉冲式的，如果伊朗反应克制，BTC跌到$76K附近反而可能快速收回。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位对冲一下，重仓赌方向在这种行情里是送钱。

Broadcom leans on customized AI chips to challenge Nvidia—why should the crypto market be nervous?

Broadcom’s AI chip business is exploding, aiming straight at Nvidia’s dominant position. If the US stock AI narrative changes, crypto prices will come under pressure.

In Broadcom’s latest results, the standout segment is its AI custom chips (ASICs). Its main customers are huge cloud providers—Google, Meta, and others. They’re no longer content with being “held by the throat” by Nvidia, and they’ve started looking to Broadcom to build chips tailored to them. In plain terms: AI compute procurement is shifting from “buying finished products” to “building in-house,” loosening the one-vendor-for-all grip that Nvidia has held. This is, by nature, a power game within the US semiconductor circle—but Crypto Briefing reports on it specifically, suggesting the transmission chain has already reached the crypto world.

Market impact
The transmission path is very specific: after BTC pulled back from its peak this cycle, its correlation with the Nasdaq has never really broken. The AI sector (NVDA, AVGO, etc.) is the engine driving the US bull market. If Broadcom’s rise triggers worries that profits from the “AI arms race” are being diluted, tech stock valuations could retrace → overall risk sentiment cools down → the crypto market follows. Right now, BTC is at $77,728.64, up only 1.47% in the past 24 hours, and volume isn’t particularly strong. ETH at $2,396.01 looks even weaker.

- Short term: If AI stocks see volatility because the competitive landscape changes, BTC will most likely trade in a range as well. The support around the $76K area is the first line of defense.
- Medium term: If custom chips truly dilute Nvidia’s profits, momentum for the Nasdaq could weaken—meaning the crypto market loses one of its most important sources of external liquidity.

My take
In the short run, I’m leaning cautiously. I think this is an underestimated bearish signal. It’s not saying that everything will crash tomorrow, but rather that the “exclusive dividend period” of the AI narrative is coming to an end, and the model where crypto relies on US stock liquidity as a backstop will become increasingly fragile. If BTC holds $76K, it can keep ranging; breaking below it could accelerate a further dip. If I’m wrong, go easy on me—I’m only hedging with a small position. I have about a 60% confidence level in this view, and the remaining 40% is up to the market.

Standard Chartered begins selling BTC and ETH directly in Dubai: Why Middle Eastern money is bypassing the United States?

Standard Chartered Bank has launched spot BTC/ETH trading in the UAE, giving institutional capital a new entry point.

Standard Chartered announced that it will provide spot Bitcoin and Ethereum trading services in the UAE region, emphasizing that it is the first global bank to do so in the UAE. This isn’t some gimmick from a small exchange—it’s an institutional-grade channel from a licensed international bank. Previously, Middle East sovereign funds and family offices who wanted to touch BTC had to route via Singapore or Europe. Now, there’s a compliant on-ramp right at their doorstep. In the past two years, the UAE has been racing ahead in crypto regulation, and Dubai’s VARA license is already becoming industry standard. With Standard Chartered’s rollout, it effectively fills the last institutional puzzle piece.

One-sentence translation: The question is no longer whether traditional finance should enter crypto, but which jurisdiction gets there first.

Market impact
- Short term: Positive for sentiment. BTC is currently $77,639.85 (24h +1.31%), ETH is $2,397.43 (+1.10%). Once the news lands, it could add fuel to choppy trading. But honestly, there’s a time lag between a bank announcing services and real money flowing in—don’t expect to see orders totaling hundreds of millions tomorrow.
- Medium term: This is the real focus. After Hong Kong, Singapore, and Dubai all become connected channels, the pipelines for institutional participation are basically covered across global time zones. Beyond the U.S. ETF growth curve, a second growth track is taking shape, which is a tangible improvement to BTC’s long-term liquidity structure.

My view
Slightly bullish, but this is a medium-term thesis rather than a short-term catalyst. With BTC around $77,639.85, first watch whether it can hold above $100.23K. If it retests $100.23K and doesn’t break, the structure remains healthy. For ETH at $2,397.43—this level has been grinding for quite some time—adding another institutional channel is a marginal positive improvement for ETH. I have a 70% confidence in this view. The remaining 30% depends on the market—between the bank’s announcement and capital actually arriving, there’s always a distance (how long it is, nobody knows).

Oil prices surge + tensions with Iran escalate—why is BTC still standing at 77K?

The Iran conflict pushes up oil prices, warms global inflation expectations, and tears a hole in the rate-cut narrative, putting pressure on risk assets.

As the situation in Iran escalates, crude oil prices jump straight up. The transmission path into crypto is very specific: oil prices rise → global inflation expectations increase → countries’ central banks have less room to cut rates → liquidity expectations worsen → a pure liquidity-sensitive asset like BTC gets hit first. Simply put: it’s not that money is leaving crypto; it’s that the expectation that “the faucet will be turned on” is being delayed. Right now BTC is at $77,685.98, up only 1.44% over the past 24 hours. ETH is at $2,394.55, up 1.00%—with this kind of gain on the day of the geopolitical conflict, it suggests haven capital hasn’t poured in at scale yet; the market is watching and waiting.

Market impact
- Short term: sentiment is bearish. Higher oil prices lift inflation → expectations of Fed rate cuts get pushed back → ETF inflows slow down → BTC directly loses its most recent major buying support. If oil keeps spiking, BTC will most likely pull back; first support to watch is around the $75K area.
- Medium term: if the conflict escalates, institutions’ risk appetite falls, and liquidity for altcoins gets drained first (SOL and XRP may still look okay with strong intraday gains, but once geopolitical risk fully brews, they can drop faster than BTC). If the conflict cools quickly, this move could just be a fakeout.

My take
Bearish in the short term—within the next 12 hours, BTC is likely to retest below $76K. The logic is simple: inflation expectations suppress the rate-cut narrative, and once ETF buying slows, price support mostly comes from spot retail, which isn’t very reliable. But I’m only 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% is up to the market—no one can predict the timing of geopolitical escalation. Once a ceasefire message comes out, the trend could flip immediately. My own response is to lower expectations, keep my position size unchanged, and wait for oil to give clear direction before deciding. If I’m wrong, feel free to lightly roast me.

油价暴涨+伊朗冲突升级，BTC为什么反而还站在77K？

伊朗冲突推高油价，全球通胀预期升温，降息叙事被撕了个口子，风险资产承压。

伊朗局势升级，原油价格直接拉升。这事对币圈的传导路径很具体：油价涨→全球通胀预期抬升→各国央行降息的空间被压缩→流动性预期变差→BTC这种纯流动性敏感资产最先挨刀。简单说：不是钱要离开币圈，而是“水龙头要晚点开”的预期变强了。目前BTC在$77,685.98，24小时只涨了1.44%，ETH $2,394.55涨1.00%——地缘冲突当天这种涨幅，说明避险资金还没大规模进场，市场在观望。

对市场的影响
- 短期：情绪偏空。油价推高通胀→美联储降息推迟预期→ETF资金流入放缓→BTC直接失去最近最大的买盘支撑。若油价持续冲高，BTC大概率回踩，下方先看$75K一带能不能接住。
- 中期：冲突若升级，机构风险偏好下降，山寨币流动性先被抽走（SOL、XRP这种日内涨幅看着还行，但地缘风险一旦发酵，跌得会比BTC快）。若冲突快速降温，这波就是假摔。

我的判断
短期偏空，12小时内BTC大概率回测$76K下方。逻辑很简单：通胀预期压制降息叙事，ETF买盘一放缓，价格支撑就只剩现货散户，那是不牢靠的。但这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场——地缘冲突的节奏谁也说不准，一旦停火消息出来，走势会立刻反转。我自己的应对是降低预期、不动仓位，等油价给出方向再定。说错轻喷。

一句话翻译：油价这把火，烧的不是币，是降息的时间表。

Coldcard hackers swap stolen funds for ETH: why is THORChain always the laundering highway?

Coldcard thieves moved about 10% of the stolen funds, using THORChain for cross-chain swapping into ETH, as on-chain investigators close in.

The third wave of hackers targeting the Coldcard wallet supply chain has started moving money. Researchers traced a batch of stolen BTC that were converted into ETH via the THORChain cross-chain protocol and landed on a new Ethereum address, with the scale roughly around 10% of the total stolen amount. In plain terms, the hackers are testing their exit route: launder a small batch first to see whether on-chain analytics firms can keep up, then decide how to handle the remaining 90%. Because THORChain is permissionless and offers strong cross-chain anonymity, it has long been a top choice for swapping stolen funds onto other chains, and was pointed out multiple times last year.

Market impact
- Short term: When hackers swap into ETH, it implies they may later dump ETH; the 10% figure is just the advance party. On-chain tracking will pin down this address, and any large transfers are a sentiment-negative. BTC is currently $77,763.74—pressure in the near term, but the structure has not broken.
- Medium term: Coldcard is a foundational trust pillar for hardware wallets. A third-wave attack plus stolen-funds circulation will accelerate money flowing to exchanges and multisig custody transfers, undermining the self-custody narrative. Regulators may also seize the opportunity to tighten compliance requirements for cross-chain protocols.

My take
Bearish—especially for ETH. The hackers still have around 90% of the stolen funds waiting to be laundered; after converting to ETH, the exit plan is basically either mixing services or direct selling. Every resistance level for ETH above $2,398.66 could become the hackers’ selling zone. The BTC impact is more indirect—if $77,763.74 can hold, it’s not a big issue. I only kept a small position to observe the subsequent moves of this address; I’m about 70% confident in this assessment, with the remaining 30% depending on whether on-chain funds truly flow to exchanges. Directionally, I’m cautious and not in a rush to go long.

One-sentence translation: Stolen funds are starting to move—the hackers’ selling pressure hasn’t really landed yet, but the market needs to digest this uncertainty first.

XRP is down 27% this year, yet on-chain stablecoins and RWA are exploding—so what exactly is the price waiting for?

XRP has fallen 27% over the first eight months, but stablecoins and tokenized assets on XRPL are expanding against the trend—there’s a serious disconnect between price and fundamentals.

Bitcoin.com highlights an unusual phenomenon: over the first eight months of 2026, XRP is down 27%, yet activity on the XRP Ledger is moving in the exact opposite direction—stablecoin issuance is rising, the size of tokenized assets (RWA) is growing, and Ripple’s institutional infrastructure is also being rolled out. In plain terms: the more “on-chain” gets used, the livelier it becomes, while the coin price keeps looking weaker. Current XRP is at $1.368.368, down 2.79% in the past 24 hours. This “fundamentals up, price down” wedge is not rare among altcoins, but this time XRP’s gap is especially large.

One-sentence takeaway: the network is being used for real, but the buy-side isn’t recognizing it—for now.

Impact on the market
- Short term: The divergence itself isn’t a reason for a rally. Capital remains cautious toward altcoins overall. BTC is ranging around $77,856, and the main capital inflow hasn’t spilled over into assets like XRP. In the short run, it will likely keep grinding.
- Medium term: Stablecoins + RWA are one of the few narratives in this cycle with real incremental growth. Ripple is deeply positioned on the institutional side. If the scale of tokenized assets continues to expand, XRP—being a ledger-native asset—will eventually need to be repriced. But “eventually” could mean half a year, or it could mean one year.

My view
I’m moderately neutral to slightly bullish, but not rushing. Reason: on-chain data doesn’t lie, and the actual usage of stablecoins and RWA is a hard metric. However, price turning points usually lag fundamentals by one to two quarters. Chasing in now is basically betting on timing. I’m only testing with a small position—if XRP breaks below $1.368.368, I’ll reevaluate this logic. I’m about 70% confident; the remaining 30% I’m leaving to the market—because for altcoins, patience is never about technicals. It’s about whether you can hold.📉

XRP前八个月跌27%，但XRPL上的稳定币、代币化资产逆势扩张，价格和基本面严重背离。

Bitcoin.com统计了一个反常现象：2026年前8个月XRP跌了27%，但XRP Ledger上的活动完全反着走——稳定币发行量上升、代币化资产（RWA）规模扩大、Ripple的机构基础设施也在铺开。说白了就是：链上越干越热闹，币价越走越蔫。当前XRP报$1.368.368，24h还跌了2.79%。这种“基本面涨、价格跌”的剪刀差，在山寨币里其实不罕见，但XRP这次裂口特别大。

一句话翻译：网络在被真实使用，但买盘暂时不认这个账。

对市场的影响
- 短期：背离本身不构成上涨理由，资金对山寨币整体谨慎。BTC在$77,856附近横着，主线资金没溢出到XRP这类资产，短期大概率继续磨。
- 中期：稳定币+RWA是这轮周期少数有真实增量的叙事，Ripple在机构端卡位很深。如果代币化资产规模继续膨胀，XRP作为账本原生资产迟早要重定价——但“迟早”这个词，可能是半年也可能是一年。

我偏中性略看多，但不急。理由：链上数据不会说谎，稳定币和RWA的真实用量是硬指标；但价格拐点通常滞后基本面一到两个季度，现在追进去等于赌时间。我自己也就小仓位试探，跌破$1.368.368我会重新审视这个逻辑。这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场——山寨币的耐心考验从来不是技术面，是你能不能熬。📉

Solana Passes Deflation Speed-Up with 67% of Votes: Is This Really Scarcity—or a Trap in Staking Rewards?

💡 Impact assessment: Bullish for SOL in the medium to long term; limited market reaction in the short term.

Solana validators voted to accelerate the reduction of SOL emissions, with a 67% approval rate—directly affecting SOL’s scarcity and staking returns.

What’s going on
The Solana community has just completed a key vote: adjusting the token emission schedule to accelerate the reduction of inflation, with a 67% approval rate. In plain terms, the number of new coins minted will be smaller and smaller, making SOL scarcer. The good side is supply contraction and a stronger value narrative; the cost is that validators and stakers’ returns will shrink, and in the long run it may affect node operator enthusiasm—nobody wants to run machines at a loss. One sentence summary: SOL wants to follow Bitcoin’s “scarcity narrative,” but it has to clear the hurdle of staking economics first.

Market impact
- Short term: SOL trades at $100.51 (24h +1.47%). On the day the news landed, price volatility was not big, suggesting the market already had expectations—this is a quiet “buy the rumor, sell the news” phase. The overall market tone is warm, with BTC at $77,856 and ETH at $2,402 both slightly up.
- Medium term: Supply-side tightening is a slow-moving variable; the real impact won’t show up in circulating supply until after a few quarters. The risk is that once staking yields fall, some large stakers may pull out, which could actually increase near-term selling pressure.

My take
I’m leaning bullish on the direction, but this is a 6–12 month logic—not something for tomorrow. Quantum computers haven’t arrived yet—so why does Fidelity pour cold water on BTC first?

Fidelity says it’s technically feasible to upgrade Bitcoin to resist quantum attacks, but the community consensus hurdle is even harder than the technical one.

Fidelity Digital Assets published a research piece, and its core message is basically this: if you replace Bitcoin’s existing signature scheme with a quantum-resistant one, it can be done technically. The real bottleneck is “how to get global miners, nodes, and BTC holders to agree.” Put simply: the plan exists, but the governance questions—who makes the final decision and how to migrate coins in old addresses—are far more difficult than the cryptography itself, by an order of magnitude. In theory, quantum computers could break today’s elliptic-curve signatures. But right now, there isn’t a practical quantum machine that can threaten BTC—this is a “long-term risk, near-term debate.”

One-sentence translation: It’s not that BTC is doomed tomorrow; it’s that changing the code would require millions of people to nod in agreement—which is harder than writing the code.

Market impact
- Short term: Neutral to slightly bearish on sentiment. BTC is currently $77,893.42, up only 1.12% in the last 24h. Discussions about these “forward-looking technical risks” won’t change the direction of capital flows, but they will give bears talking points. ETH at $2,406.03 is basically flat; up just 0.24% in 24h—little to no impact.
- Medium term: If institutions proactively study the quantum threat, that actually suggests Fidelity-type large players are doing long-term due diligence—an annotation of the institutionalization process. When the day truly comes that a hard fork is needed, that’s when the real volatility show starts.

Neutral—don’t act. This news does not constitute a directional catalyst. For BTC, I’ll keep looking for the $77,893 area to remain in a choppy consolidation structure, with support at the prior low range. My take is: Fidelity saying it’s “feasible but challenging” is exactly the most standard institutional wording—signals agreement while avoiding liability. 量子计算机还没打进来，富达为什么先给BTC泼冷水？

富达说BTC抗量子升级技术上可行，但社区共识这关比技术还难过。

富达数字资产发了篇研究，核心就一句：比特币换成抗量子签名算法，技术上做得到，真正卡脖子的是“怎么让全球矿工、节点、持币人达成一致”。说白了就是：方案有，但谁来拍板、怎么迁移旧地址里的币，这些治理问题比密码学本身难十倍。理论上量子计算机能破解现有椭圆曲线签名，但目前还没有能威胁BTC的实用化量子机器，属于“远期风险、近期议题”。

一句话翻译：不是明天就完蛋，是想改代码需要几百万人点头，这比写代码难。

中性，不动。这消息不构成方向性催化剂，BTC短线继续看$77,893附近的震荡结构，支撑看前低区间。我的看法是：富达说“可行但有挑战”恰恰是最标准的机构措辞——既表态又不担责。这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场，说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位观察着。

title: BTC守住7.7万，但真正的考验还在后头油价90美元+加息概率68%，宏观“三座大山”同时压顶。
subTitle:
一、先说盘面
BTC目前在77,000-77,500区间震荡，24小时小幅反弹约0.1%。ETH同步在2,410附近整理。
过去一周，BTC从81,000上方跌至76,800附近，完成了一轮超过5,000点的回调。但有个细节值得注意：跌到77,000之后，盘面稳住了，没有再继续往下砸。
利空这么多，没继续崩——这是“该跌不跌”的信号。
二、宏观面：三座大山同时压顶
第一座：油价冲上90美元
布伦特原油重返90美元/桶上方，受美伊冲突持续升级影响。ISM制造业指数的价格分项连续第二个月保持在71.1的高位，受访者普遍反映燃料和石油制品等商品价格正在上涨。
传导链：地缘冲突→油价暴涨→通胀预期升温→加息预期巩固。
第二座：9月加息概率飙至68%
CME FedWatch最新数据显示，美联储9月加息25个基点的概率已升至68%。一个半月前市场还在讨论“降息”，现在加息已接近“板上钉钉”。
沃什在杰克逊霍尔说得很清楚：过去六个月PCE年化通胀率4.1%，过去一年3.7%，离2%的目标还远。他强调，必须确信潜在通胀正在明确且足够快地朝着目标移动，否则“我们还有工作要做”。
第三座：就业市场“弱而不崩”
7月JOLTS职位空缺数据显示招聘活动疲软，ISM就业指数也在下降。730万份新增岗位和油价90美元同时出现，市场正在面对一个“高通胀、弱就业”的矛盾组合，货币政策路径变得极其复杂。
三、8月涨了25%，但9月是最难熬的月份
8月比特币累计上涨约25%，创下自2021年以来首个正收益的8月，表现仅次于2017年的65.6%和2013年的30.7%。
但CoinGlass长期追踪数据显示，9月历来是比特币表现最疲软的月份之一，历史平均回报率在-3%至-4%之间，自2014年以来平均跌幅约2.2%。
更重要的是宏观预期反转。8月行情建立在“财政部回购国债→流动性改善→美元信用交易”的逻辑上。但进入9月后，这个逻辑正在被加息预期“逆推”。

四、本周到9月中旬，需要盯紧的几个节点

五、夜读操作思路
77,000附近不追涨、不恐慌：这个位置缩量企稳，说明有承接等非农数据落地再动：数据出来前不加杠杆、不重仓关注7.3万-7.5万防线：这是多头底线，守住了结构性没坏8.3万是牛熊分水岭：放量站稳才算真正转强
夜读最后一句：宏观偏鹰是事实，但BTC在77,000“该跌不跌”也是事实。9月FOMC之前，方向没完全明朗，控制仓位、耐心等待，比盲目押注更重要。本周五非农数据，夜读持续盯盘，关键信号第一时间在群里发。🚀

Even the rebound in Asian equities can’t prop up ETH; chasing longs got stuck above 2400.

As of 16:00, the latest $ETH closed its 4H candle from an open of 2403.29, with a high of 2419.33 and a low of 2379.41, and ultimately closed at 2398.68—falling back below 2400. Trading volume was 40,528 ETH, which is 18.5% lower than the average of the previous 5 candles and 16.2% lower than the previous 20. What’s more striking is that aggressive buying accounts for 59.6%; nearly 60% still can’t turn it into a bullish candle. The previous rebound candle closed at 2403.30; this one rose to a high but closed lower instead, suggesting increasing buy-side depletion while the structure hasn’t lifted. In the same period, $BTC closed at 77,663.15; ETH/BTC closed at 0.03089, with five consecutive 4H candles staying below 0.03100. Relative capital preference still favors BTC; those trapped are the people who mistook heavy aggressive buys above 2404.80 for a breakout.

The only relevant catalyst in this window comes from the repair of Asian risk assets: a midday report showed Asian stock markets following overnight U.S. stocks higher. U.S. index futures moved up, and Brent crude slipped 0.4% to $95.26. The external environment has already provided some cushioning, yet ETH couldn’t even hold 2419.33 this time. This failure looks more like relative weakness within the coin rather than a one-way macro selloff.

I’m clearly bearish on ETH: at about 2407.95 USD before 16:05 of publication, the first target was 2379.41, and the second target was 2370.14. If the 4H candle hasn’t closed, it only confirms the timing—not my directional bias. This is only market commentary and does not constitute investment advice. #ETH #行情分析

In the comments, there’s only one bet: will the aggressive buying run out first, or will 2370.14 be retested first?

🔍 Broad market declines, yet the Greed Index is still above 65: Why isn’t anyone panicking this pullback?

💡 Impact on judgment: Short-term bearish. Prices are falling, but sentiment is still in the greed zone—suggesting leveraged longs haven’t been fully washed out.

📊 Key data
• Fear & Greed Index: 65 (Greed). Even on down days, it still holds in the greed zone
• All four major coins—BTC, ETH, SOL, and BNB—closed lower across the board
• Timing: Early September, a window when derivatives liquidity is relatively thin

One-sentence translation: What’s dropping is the price, not confidence—there are still more bottom-fishers than people cutting losses.

📝 Analysis

1. Falling without panic is itself a risk signal
The typical pullback script is: price drops → sentiment cools → leverage gets cleaned up → stabilization. Now prices are down, yet the Greed Index is still at 65, which means bullish sentiment hasn’t drained yet and leveraged longs are still packed in. In this kind of structure, the main force can lift it with little effort, but when they sell it down, it’s also effortless.

2. Sentiment lags behind price—and will need to catch up eventually
Historically, most solid bottoms come with the Greed Index returning to neutral or even the fear zone. A reading of 65 means this lesson in sentiment hasn’t been made up—either it chops sideways while it bleeds down on its own, or another sharp selloff comes and drives it lower. Neither path is friendly to short-term long positions.

3. Don’t treat a quick spike needle as a trend, and don’t treat it as a bottom
In early month plus the Asian session morning, pullbacks under thin liquidity are often amplified. At this spot, it’s neither a good entry to chase shorts, nor a good level to catch a falling knife.

💡 Conclusion
My view is straightforward: short-term bearish—wait for sentiment to catch up. Don’t add or bottom-fish until the Greed Index returns below 50, or until BTC reclaims today’s lost ground. If you already have positions, first reduce leverage. Sideways consolidation is the better outcome; a sharp drop to “catch up” is the more likely one.

The Fed is rewriting its inflation playbook: this time it’s not rate cuts—it’s a change of mind?

Fed Chair Warsh set up five special working groups at Jackson Hole to rebuild the central bank’s analytical framework, directly affecting the path of rate cuts.

💡 Neutral-to-bullish: rebuilding the framework often means admitting the old model has failed, and loose-policy expectations may heat up.

What’s going on
At this year’s Jackson Hole summit, the newly appointed Fed Chair Kevin Warsh announced the formation of five task forces, focusing on key areas including inflation modeling, the data system, and balance-sheet management. They will comprehensively overturn the analytical approach the central bank has used for years. In plain terms, this is the official acknowledgment that the old forecasting tools are no longer keeping up with the market. There are no specific dollar figures, but this is an institutional “surgery” that carries far more weight than any single rate decision.

One-sentence translation: the Fed stops pretending it understands the economy and starts wearing a new pair of glasses.

Impact on the market
- Short term: BTC is at $77,681.16 (24h +0.17%), ETH at $2,400.2 (-0.82%). The market reaction is still fairly restrained. But a “reassessment of the framework” is usually seen as a prelude to a policy shift, and the dovish narrative may slowly build.
- Medium term: If the new framework acknowledges that the neutral rate and inflation transmission mechanism have changed, the bar for rate cuts could be materially lower—liquidity expectations are exactly what the crypto market eats up. The risk is policy uncertainty during the transition period.

My take

其次，由于没有一口气突破箱体的压制，这里上涨动能的连续性就有待观察了。

这个看下来，各个周期似乎都有自己的想法，所以接下来的走势难免复杂多变，但综合考量，周线月线大周期表现出的想歇口气再涨的概率更高一些。

The stablecoin legislation hearing is over—what is the U.S. really up to with the dollar?

Circle CEO Tarbert testified before Congress, talking about how the dollar can stay on top by using stablecoins.

Circle is the issuer of USDC, the U.S.’s second-largest stablecoin, with a circulation scale exceeding $60 billion. This time, their CEO Heath Tarbert sat in the Congressional hearing seat with one central goal: to push stablecoin regulatory legislation through. The logic is straightforward—every USDC is pegged to $1 globally, meaning that when overseas users hold USDC, they are effectively passively holding dollar-denominated assets. The larger the stablecoin issuance, the deeper the dollar’s global penetration goes. Tarbert previously served as chairman of the CFTC, so he’s one of the “insiders” in the regulatory circle; when he makes this case, lawmakers are more likely to listen.

One-sentence translation: The U.S. has finally figured out that stablecoins are not a threat to the dollar—they’re the best tool for the dollar’s digital expansion.

- Short term: As the regulatory framework moves forward, it’s directly positive for USDC, and overall sentiment toward the stablecoin sector is somewhat warm. BTC is currently $77,816.51, up slightly by 0.3%, while ETH is $2,408.66, down a tiny 0.46%. Market reaction is fairly restrained—more like “good news heard, but not excited yet.”
- Medium term: Once the legislation is implemented, banks and payment giants will enter to issue stablecoins. The total on-chain “dollar” supply would take another step up, meaning the entire crypto market’s underlying liquidity would become meaningfully thicker. This is a slow-moving variable—it won’t be realized overnight.

My take
I’m moderately bullish, but with limited conviction. This kind of hearing is directionally positive, not a catalyst for a short-term trading spike. From a few thousand U to over ten million—it's not about gambling, it's about stability!!

To be honest, when I first got into the crypto market, I had dreams like that too: put money in today, double tomorrow, financial freedom the day after tomorrow. Later, the market taught me a few hard lessons and I finally understood: people who want to get rich overnight are usually the first to get knocked out. #ETH 

My start was just a few thousand U. I’m not a whale, and I don’t have any insider info. I’m just an ordinary retail trader. Now my account has climbed to over fifty million. If you ask me for a secret, I really can’t give you some flashy theory. It’s just one sentence: I never greedily chase how much I can make in this wave—I only ask myself whether I should enter this trade or not. $AKE 

At the very beginning, my account had a little over 1,000 U. I was so broke I even felt reluctant to use a decent stop-loss.
I split that money into several parts, and every time I only moved a small amount—like squeezing toothpaste. Before each order, my take-profit and stop-loss were nailed down tightly: I don’t chase pumps, I don’t hold positions while resisting losses, and if I can’t read the chart, I don’t touch it.

Those days I wasn’t thinking about making money. All I could think about was one thing: surviving—survive today, survive until the next cycle. $HEMI 

Later, my account started to grow gradually. My position size became a bit bolder, but I always held on to one iron rule: the percentage I use in any single trade must never exceed that certain number of the total funds.

When the market finally moves the way it should, I only add to my position little by little along the trend. I don’t rush to be in the very first breakout candlestick, and I don’t bet on catching the very last tail. I just eat the middle part—the fattiest, most stable stretch.

In plain terms, I don’t race the market to the starting line, and I don’t fight it. Whatever it gives me, I take it.
When my account reaches a certain size, I actually get more and more cautious.

Every week I withdraw a fixed amount of profit from my account. Not because I’m afraid of losing—but because I’m too clear on this: once people get complacent here, it’s not far from getting liquidated.

I’ve seen too many people. Their technical skills are better than mine, and their sense of direction is sharper than mine. In the end, their accounts are gone. Why? They spray their position sizes wildly, their stop-loss is basically useless. They were right on direction—but they stubbornly held on until liquidation, and they were left with not even a breath to spare.

Making money isn’t a problem if it’s slower. It really doesn’t matter. Living longer matters infinitely more than making it big fast! #美国8月ADP就业创1月来最小增幅

我起步也就几千U，不是什么大户，更没什么内幕消息，就是个再普通不过的散户。现在账户爬到五千多万，你要问我秘诀，我真说不出一套花里胡哨的理论，就一句话：我从来不贪这一波能赚多少，我只问自己这一波该不该上$AKE 

最开始账户里就1000U出头，穷得连个像样的止损都心疼。
我把那点钱拆成好几份，每次只动一小块，跟挤牙膏似的。每一单进场之前，止盈止损焊得死死的，不追涨，不扛单，看不懂的走势碰都不碰。

那段日子我没想着赚钱，满脑子就一件事先活下来，活到下一轮行情$HEMI 

后来账户慢慢滚起来了，仓位敢放大一点了，但始终压着一个铁规矩：单次动用的比例绝对不能超过总资金的那个数。

行情真走出来的时候，我也只顺着趋势一点一点加仓，不抢第一根启动的K线，不赌最后一根尾巴，就吃中间那段最肥最稳的肉。

说白了，我不跟市场抢跑，也不跟它较劲，它给多少我接多少。
等到账户做到一定规模以后，我反而越来越怂了。

每周固定从账户里提一笔利润出来，不是怕亏，是太清楚这地方人一飘，离爆仓就不远了。

我见过太多人，技术比我好，方向看得比我准，最后账户没了。为什么？仓位乱甩，止损形同虚设，方向看对了，硬扛到爆仓，连口气都没剩下。

赚钱这事儿，慢一点真的没关系。活得久，比赚得猛，重要一万倍！

title: 加密货币期权市场的定价偏差与交易启示
subTitle:
——基于纳西姆·塔勒布思想的观察与思考
一份面向期权交易实践的思考笔记
一、引言：混乱中的初生市场
加密货币期权市场，是一个仍处于早期阶段的金融场域。它机制上已相对完善，却在参与者行为与定价逻辑上呈现出显著的混乱特征。投资者往往将期权简单等同于另一种高杠杆的期货工具，缺乏对时间价值、波动率与尾部风险的真正理解。这种认知偏差，直接导致市场定价长期处于模糊状态，短周期合约盛行，买卖双方在订单簿上形成明显割裂。
然而，正如纳西姆·塔勒布（Nassim Nicholas Taleb）在其著作中反复强调的那样，混乱本身并不必然意味着无序的毁灭，它也可能是凸性收益的土壤。市场越是定价不充分、参与者越是依赖直觉与侥幸，那些真正理解非对称性与尾部风险的交易者，就越有可能从中获得结构性优势。加密期权市场正是这样一个放大镜：它将传统期权市场中本已存在的偏差，以更极端、更清晰的方式呈现出来。
二、市场混乱的具体表现：短期合约与订单簿割裂
当前加密期权市场最显著的特征之一，是近期合约的极度活跃。单日、三日、一周到期的期权占据了相当大的交易比重。这些合约杠杆极高，时间衰减极快，本质上更接近于纯粹的方向性赌博，而非对波动率或尾部事件的定价工具。
在这类合约中，买卖双方的心理预期严重分裂。卖方往往心存侥幸，不愿意以合理价格出售期权，寄希望于标的价格在极短时间内不发生大幅波动；买方则试图在订单簿中挂出足够低的价格“捡漏”。结果是，买方出价与卖方要价之间经常出现巨大缺口，订单簿长期处于失衡状态。这种割裂并非源于流动性不足本身，而是源于对期权本质认知的缺失——参与者把期权当作高杠杆期货在交易，而非一种具有非线性收益结构的风险转移工具。
从交易实践的角度看，短期合约市场更接近于一个“混乱的赌市”。定价不充分所带来的额外成本，往往由交易者自己承担。试图在其中寻找稳定的统计优势，难度远高于在更长期的合约中寻找定价偏差。
三、中远期期权：被系统性低估的尾部可能
与短期合约形成鲜明对比的，是中远期期权的定价状态。加密资产（尤其是比特币与以太坊）在日线乃至周线级别上，几乎每个月都可能出现相当可观的波动。然而，当行权价显著偏离当前现货价格、且到期时间拉长至一至数月时，期权价格往往显得异常“便宜”。
以以太坊为例，当现货价格在2400美元附近时，两个月后行权价为3000美元的看涨期权，权利金可能仅有数美元至十余美元。表面上看，这一价格似乎合理——毕竟从2400上涨至3000并非高概率事件。但实际上，这种“合理”建立在对真实概率的系统性低估之上。加密市场的波动特征，远非传统正态分布所能描述；极端行情出现的频率与幅度，往往超出基于历史波动率或标准定价模型的推演。
这里的低估，并非单纯由交易者的侥幸心理造成，更深层的原因在于期权定价公式本身的局限。当标的价格偏离程度较大、时间跨度拉长时，模型对尾部概率的估计能力显著下降。塔勒布在《动态对冲》与《黑天鹅》中反复指出：越是极端、越是远离当前观察值的事件，我们对其真实发生概率的认知就越不可靠。加密市场的高波动与厚尾特征，将这一模型缺陷放大到了更为显著的程度。
四、期权定价的内在局限：模型、隐含波动率与黑天鹅
许多人会问：既然定价公式存在通病，为何市场不加以修正？答案在于，这些“通病”并非简单的计算错误，而是认知边界与现实世界复杂性之间的根本张力。
塔勒布对此有深刻洞察。他指出，对于远期且极端的期权，定价不充分是由诸多客观因素决定的——我们永远无法精确获知真实世界中极端事件发生的真实概率。越偏远、越极端，偏差就越大。模型依赖的是对过去的外推与对已知分布的假设，而现实中真正改变游戏规则的，往往是那些此前未被充分定价的事件。
另一个关键机制是隐含波动率（Implied Volatility）。它被定义为将市场价格反推回定价模型后得到的波动率数值，反映市场对未来波动幅度的预期。当市场已知将有重大事件（如美联储决议、非农数据）时，隐含波动率会提前抬升，期权价格随之上升。这看起来合理，却掩盖了一个更本质的问题：
大家都知道的问题，往往已经不是真正的问题。信息维度高度同质化的时刻，定价反而可能过度充分甚至高估。真正决定价格长期结构的，是那些“看不见的问题”——塔勒布所称的黑天鹅。当已知事件尘埃落定，市场进入所谓的“平静期”，隐含波动率常降至低位，期权价格被系统性压低。此时，看不见的风险并未消失，它只是暂时不被定价。正是在这些时刻，低估的尾部期权才真正具备凸性优势。
加密市场将这一逻辑推到了极致。其信息环境更碎片化、叙事驱动更强、杠杆更高，黑天鹅事件的冲击往往来得更猛烈。因此，在隐含波动率低位、市场情绪平静时买入具有足够行权距离与时间价值的期权，并非简单的“赌方向”，而是在为未知的未知支付一个相对廉价的保险费。
五、哲学层面的思考：知道与不知道的非对称
塔勒布思想的核心之一，是区分“我们知道自己知道的”与“我们知道自己不知道的”，以及更危险的“我们不知道自己不知道的”。期权市场，尤其是加密期权市场，正是这种认知层次差异的绝佳实验场。
对于理解尾部风险与凸性结构的交易者而言，市场中的定价偏差是天堂——它提供了以有限成本换取不对称收益的机会。对于不理解这些结构的交易者而言，同样的市场则是毒药——他们在支付过高的时间价值去赌短期方向，或在低估的远期期权中充当了无偿的风险承担者。
更深一层看，加密期权市场并非特例，而是所有金融期权市场的一个极端缩影。传统市场中同样存在模型局限、隐含波动率的周期性低估、以及对黑天鹅的系统性忽视，只是程度较轻、被更成熟的参与者与更严格的风控所掩盖。加密市场去掉了这些缓冲，让偏差以更赤裸的方式显现。
因此，真正的交易优势，并不来自对下一个价格方向的精准预测，而来自对自身认知边界的清醒认识，以及对那些“模型无法充分定价”的区域保持敏感。这既是技术问题，也是哲学问题。
六、结语：在偏差中寻找结构
加密货币期权市场是一片充满噪音的初生之地。短期合约的混乱与中远期合约的低估并存，定价公式的局限与黑天鹅的永恒存在交织。对于那些仍将期权视为高杠杆期货的参与者，这里是昂贵的赌场；对于那些理解凸性、尾部风险与认知边界的交易者，这里则是一个可以持续观察、等待并偶尔收获不对称收益的场域。
塔勒布的思想提醒我们：世界并不按我们习惯的模型运行。真正的稳健，来自对脆弱性的主动规避，以及对那些能从混乱中受益的结构的拥抱。加密期权市场，正是检验这一原则的生动实验室。
以上观察与思考，源于对市场日常运行的持续关注，以及对塔勒布相关著作的反复阅读。它们并不构成任何投资建议，而是试图为理解这一新兴市场的定价逻辑，提供一个可能的视角。
主要参考思想来源
纳西姆·尼古拉斯·塔勒布相关著作：
《黑天鹅》（The Black Swan）
《反脆弱》（Antifragile）
《动态对冲》（Dynamic Hedging）
《非对称风险》（Skin in the Game）
《随机漫步的傻瓜》（Fooled by Randomness）

A set of thought notes aimed at practical options trading
I. Introduction: A Nascent Market Amidst Confusion
The cryptocurrency options market is a financial arena still in its early stage. Its mechanics are relatively well-developed, yet it exhibits strikingly chaotic traits in participants’ behavior and pricing logic. Investors often simply equate options with another form of high-leverage futures instruments, lacking a true understanding of time value, volatility, and tail risk. This cognitive bias directly leaves market pricing in an ambiguous state for the long term: short-cycle contracts are prevalent, and a clear split emerges between buy and sell sides on the order book.

IBIT pulled in 1,495 BTC in one day—about $115 million—showing institutions are still buying with real money.

On-chain data shows that BlackRock’s IBIT clients bought 1,495 bitcoins via the ETF, which at the current price is roughly $115 million. Based on the calculation, the approximate cost per coin is around $77,000, closely matching the current BTC price of $77,710. This indicates continuous market-price buying—not bargain hunting and not selling into strength. In the same period, ETH was reported at $2,403.98 (24h -0.80%). Among major coins, XRP and BNB saw slight gains, while the overall market is in a sideways digestion phase.

One-sentence translation: Retail investors are still hesitating, while BlackRock’s clients are steadily accumulating with market orders.

Impact on the market
- Short term: A daily net inflow of $115 million is direct buy pressure on BTC. The sideways trading near $77,700 being able to absorb it suggests there is real institutional demand underneath, compressing the room for a pullback.
- Medium term: But note the issue mentioned in the original text—funds are excessively concentrated in IBIT, and the weight of a single ETF is too large. Any redemption-related disruption would be amplified. Institutional concentration is a double-edged sword: a tailwind when markets rise, and leverage when panic hits.

My view
I’m moderately bullish, but I’ll only give it a 70% confidence level. The logic is simple: in a sideways market, there is still a $115 million daily net institutional inflow. The supply side keeps getting drained, and within the next 12 hours the probability that BTC holds above $77,000 is higher than breaking down. The key is the $77,000 support. As long as it isn’t effectively lost, the path to test prior highs to the upside isn’t damaged. The risk point is IBIT concentration—if one day it flips into large-scale net outflows, the decline could happen faster than expected. This is the crack that long positions need to watch most closely in the bullish structure. If I’m wrong, be gentle—I’m only following the institutional direction with a small position.

Blockstream founder Adam Back added an investment of $8.8 million into France’s BTC treasury firm Capital B, helping it accumulate coins to reach its target of 3,521 BTC.

Capital B is a French bitcoin treasury company. Put simply, its business model is financing that buys BTC. This time, through a private placement, it once again raised $8.8 million from Adam Back. Adam Back is not investing for the first time—he is the CEO of Blockstream, a veteran in the cryptography community, and a name mentioned as early as the Satoshi era. The objective is very clear: push its holdings to 3,521 BTC.

Impact on the market

- Medium term: The “MicroStrategy-style” path for Europe is being replicated. The trend of publicly listed companies hoarding BTC has spread from the U.S. to France, showing that institutional narratives haven’t stopped—even if prices have retreated from recent highs.

My take
This news is generally bullish, but the magnitude is moderate. Adam Back is putting in real money and making continuous additions—more credible than people who just talk up the market. I lean toward BTC stabilizing around $77,464 and then seeing a modest rebound, but $88 million isn’t enough to pry open the whole market. Don’t expect a single big bullish candle. The US 10-Year Treasury Yield Breaks Above 4.8% and Moves Closer to Recent Highs

The US 10-year Treasury yield has recently been on a steady upward trajectory, becoming an important reference point for global macro pricing. According to relevant market data and reports, as of around September 1, 2026, the yield has risen to about 4.80%, up approximately 0.04 percentage points from the prior trading day. Subsequently, quotes showed it hovering further around 4.81%, with minor intraday fluctuations. Based on public descriptions, the yield has climbed above 4.8% and is described as approaching the higher levels seen since October 2023. Over the past month, it has increased by roughly 0.12 percentage points, which is about 0.53 percentage points higher than a year ago.

In terms of the event background, the rise in yields is not driven by a single factor. Reports indicate that oil prices have been rising for multiple consecutive trading days, leading the market to worry that developments related to the Middle East could affect energy supplies and thereby push up inflation expectations. At the same time, hawkish signals released by Federal Reserve officials have been interpreted by the market as strengthening expectations for tighter policy. At the chair level, emphasis has been placed on continuing to combat inflation; and a board member stated that if inflation does not ease, the central bank should be prepared to raise rates. Market pricing for the probability of a rate hike in the month was at one point reported to be around 70%. In addition, the schedule for employment and manufacturing-related data has been densely packed, with reports such as ADP and the Nonfarm Payrolls serving as near-term indicators to gauge the policy path.

The core facts can be summarized as follows: long-end US Treasury yields have risen continuously over a short period, with nominal levels returning to above 4.8%. The main narrative drivers center on inflation concerns brought about by rising energy prices, as well as the rate-hike expectations boosted by statements from Fed officials. What needs to be distinguished is that the specific yield levels, day-to-day changes, and the phrasing “approaching a prior historical high” come from market action and news summaries; meanwhile, claims such as “a rate hike is inevitable this month” or “inflation is certain to spiral out of control” are not verified conclusions and remain at the level of market pricing and expectations. Statistics also show that longer-dated products such as 30-year Treasuries are similarly in relatively high ranges. While shorter-dated products also move in tandem, the slope and magnitude are not entirely consistent.

From a logic breakdown perspective, the 10-year Treasury yield typically reflects a combined discounting of growth, inflation, and the policy path. If oil prices continue to rise, they may strengthen expectations for commodity and core inflation stickiness, putting both real yields and nominal yields under renewed pressure for repricing. If official messaging is more hawkish, it may compress the market’s pricing space for easing, driving a rebound in the term premium and the policy-path premium. Conversely, if employment cools later or inflation data comes in lower, the upward momentum in yields could weaken. Current reporting also notes that model forecasts for quarter-end and one year ahead do not point to a one-way, forever-rising pattern, suggesting that while the market is trading near-term risk-premium uncertainty, it still retains the assumption of a medium-term mean reversion.

Regarding how these developments affect the crypto market, the transmission mechanism is more indirect—via macro liquidity and risk appetite—rather than a mechanical mapping from a single bond price. When long-end US Treasury yields rise, it often corresponds to marginal tightening in US-dollar funding conditions and higher risk-free rates, which in turn lifts the discount rates applied to various risk assets. In such an environment, high-volatility crypto assets may face valuation compression and heightened pressure to deleverage. If rate-hike expectations intensify, arbitrage and leverage structures related to stablecoins and dollar liquidity could become even more sensitive. On the other hand, if yields rise mainly due to growth resilience rather than purely due to tightening shocks, risk assets sometimes exhibit a more complex combination such as a “bear-steepening” curve alongside coexistence of risk appetite and risk-off pressures. Therefore, a more robust observation framework is to treat Treasury yields as one of the global pricing anchors—tracking their alignment with oil prices, employment, inflation, and official statements—rather than directly equating them to a switch that determines crypto’s up or down moves.

In terms of the editor’s judgment and monitoring points, the key validation aspects of this round of narrative are: whether the yield level above 4.8% and the description “approaching the high since October 2023” are sustained in subsequent trading days; whether oil prices and geopolitical disruptions are short-lived pulses or longer-lasting trends; and whether employment data can revise the probability of rate hikes. For readers, it is important to separate the already-occurring yield rise from policy outcomes that have not yet materialized, avoiding the misinterpretation of probability pricing as an official policy announcement. Cross-validation of macro variables remains the first principle; a single yield point is not sufficient to uniquely determine the market cycle on its own.

美十年期国债收益率升破4.8%逼近近年高位

美国10年期国债收益率近期持续上行，成为全球宏观定价的重要参照。据相关市场数据与报道，截至2026年9月1日前后，该收益率升至约4.80%，较上一交易日上行约0.04个百分点；随后报价进一步显示在约4.81%附近，日内亦有小幅波动。综合公开叙述，收益率已攀升至4.8%上方，并被描述为逼近2023年10月以来的较高水平。过去约一个月累计上行约0.12个百分点，较一年前高出约0.53个百分点。

事件背景上，收益率抬升并非单一因素驱动。报道指出，油价连续多个交易日上涨，市场担忧中东相关局势可能影响能源供应，从而推高通胀预期。与此同时，美联储相关官员释放的鹰派信号被市场解读为强化了政策收紧预期：主席层面强调继续打击通胀，理事亦表示若通胀未能缓解，央行应做好加息准备。市场对当月加息概率的定价一度被报道至约七成左右。此外，就业与制造业相关数据日程密集，ADP与非农等报告成为观察政策路径的即时线索。

核心事实可归纳为：长端美债收益率在短周期内连续走高，名义水平回到4.8%上方；驱动叙事集中在能源价格上行带来的通胀担忧，以及美联储官员讲话推高的加息预期。需要区分的是，收益率具体点位、日度变动与“接近某历史区间高点”的表述来自行情与新闻摘要；而“本月必然加息”或“通胀必然失控”并不构成已验证结论，仍属市场定价与预期层面。统计表还显示30年期等更长端品种同步处在相对高位区间，短端品种亦有联动，但斜率与幅度并不完全一致。

从逻辑拆解看，10年期美债收益率通常反映增长、通胀与政策路径的综合折现。油价上行若持续，可能推升商品与核心通胀粘性预期，令实际利率与名义利率同时承压重估；若官方表态偏鹰，会压缩市场对宽松的定价空间，推动期限溢价与政策路径溢价回升。反之，若后续就业降温或通胀数据回落，收益率上行动能可能减弱。当前报道同时提示，模型预测对季末与一年后的点位并不指向单向永远走高，说明市场在交易近端风险溢价的同时，仍保留中期均值回归假设。

对加密市场的影响路径，更多是通过宏观流动性与风险偏好间接传导，而非单一债券价格的机械映射。长端美债收益率上行，往往对应美元融资条件边际收紧、无风险利率抬升，从而抬高各类风险资产的折现率；在此环境下，高波动的加密资产可能面临估值压缩与杠杆去化压力。若加息预期升温，稳定币与美元流动性相关的套利与杠杆结构也可能更敏感。另一方面，若收益率上行主要来自增长韧性而非单纯紧缩冲击，风险资产有时会出现“熊陡”与风险偏好并存的复杂组合。因此，更稳妥的观察框架是：把美债收益率当作全球定价锚之一，跟踪其与油价、就业、通胀和官方表态的共振，而不是把它直接等同于加密涨跌开关。

编辑判断与观察上，本轮叙事的关键验证点在于：4.8%上方的收益率水平与“逼近2023年10月以来高位”的描述是否被后续交易日延续；油价与地缘扰动是脉冲还是趋势；就业数据能否修正加息概率。对读者而言，应把已发生的收益率上行与尚未落地的政策结果分开看待，避免把概率定价误读为政策公告。宏观变量交叉验证仍是第一原则，单一收益率点位不足以单独定性市场周期。

Equinix teams up with Nvidia to build an AI compute marketplace, launching in Q1 2027—what does this have to do with the crypto world?
Equinix, together with Nvidia and Together AI, is working on an AI inference trading market, making it easier for enterprises to buy compute.

Equinix is one of the largest global data center REITs. This time, by bringing in Nvidia and Together AI, it plans to build an “inference exchange,” scheduled to launch in Q1 2027. In plain terms, it turns GPU compute power into a kind of product marketplace that can be purchased on demand. Enterprises won’t be locked into a single cloud provider anymore—global data centers can be accessed as needed. This is a step in AI infrastructure moving from “big tech leasing everything” to an “open market,” with rollout in Q1 2027.

Market impact
- Short term: For mainstream coins like BTC $77,512.69 and ETH $2,397.5, there’s almost no direct sentiment catalyst. At most, it adds a bit of fuel to mining/compute-related narratives tied to AI. BTC is down -0.19% in the past 24 hours, drifting lower on lower volume—this news can’t change the short-term rhythm.
- Medium term: Worth watching is the direction of compute becoming commoditized—GPU resources moving from scarce assets to tradable goods. That’s a long-term positive for the broader compute-economy narrative, and projects in the crypto space that tokenize compute may ride the same logic as a comparison. Also, when a traditional infrastructure player like Equinix enters the game, it suggests AI inference demand is already so large that it needs an “exchange” to set prices.

My take
Mostly neutral—hang back. This news is essentially a traditional infrastructure industry story, and the transmission chain to coin prices is too long to matter on a 12-hour timescale. According to alicharts data, BTC fell 5.82% from the local high of $77,744.79 on August 28, and is now quoted at $77,744.79, trading basically sideways over the past 24 hours (+0.24%). What’s interesting is that ChainCatcher tracked the whale address in this pullback—it didn’t exit. Instead, it kept buying, accumulating roughly 6,765 BTC. At the current price, the scale of this accumulation is about $520 million. In plain terms: when the price drops, the big money is catching, and the small money is panicking.

One-sentence translation: In the pullback, retail traders hand over their coins; in the pullback, whales pick them up. Historically, this kind of divergence rarely means the whale is the one that’s wrong first.

Market impact
Short term: A 5.82% correction is within a healthy retracement range. It hasn’t broken key structure. Over the past 24 hours, the price barely moved, suggesting selling pressure is weakening. Whale accumulation is a potential “catching bid,” but in the short term it won’t directly pump the price—it’s more like building a base around 77K. Over in ETH, the past 24 hours are -0.35%. Correlation is weak, but it hasn’t collapsed.

Mid term: Continued whale buying suggests big holders have not turned bearish on the medium-term trend. The process of shifting chips from retail to whales is often a prerequisite for the next leg of the move. But if the price keeps dipping and the whale continues adding until it turns into a trap, market sentiment could deteriorate again.

My take
Neutral to slightly bullish. At the 77K level, the whale is paying real money to buy, so the probability of further steep declines in the short term isn’t high. However, a reversal depends on whether it can reclaim around $77,744.79—before that, it can only be considered a rebound, not a confirmed trend. My view is to stay on the sidelines and wait for confirmation. I’m 70% confident in this assessment; the remaining 30% is left to the market—if I’m wrong, please go easy on me; I’m only following with a small position.

BTC surges for 5 minutes and liquidates $140 million in short positions—why do bears always die before dawn?

BTC climbed 5.21% in 24 hours to break above $81,182, and the $140 million in short positions were liquidated—shorts collectively paid the tuition.

Today, BTC kept pushing up to $81,182.25. In 24 hours, it rose 5.21%; ETH followed in sync, rising to $2,506.68, up 5.12%. This rally directly triggered the liquidation of $140 million in shorts—equivalent to forced buyback pressure from about 20,000 BTC. In plain terms: people who short were betting the price would fall, but the price moved the other way. The exchange closed their positions for them. These buy orders then pushed the price up again—classic short-squeeze spiral.

One-sentence translation: it’s not that more people are bullish; it’s that more people are forced to buy.

Market impact
Short term: The fuel for this short squeeze is real. The forced buyback has already been executed, but the fact that price is holding above $81K shows that bids aren’t weak. After a squeeze like this, you usually see a pullback for confirmation. As long as the pullback doesn’t break below the prior high’s lower edge, the structure is considered to have stabilized.

Medium term: ETH’s synchronized 5% rise shows this isn’t just a BTC-only story—capital is rotating back at the sector level. If spot keeps following through, this move may be a trend-launch candidate rather than just a needle-poke.

My take
Bullish, but I’m only 70% confident—the remaining 30% is left to the market. With BTC holding above $81,182, the next resistance to watch is the $85K psychological level. A pullback to $79K that can hold would be a healthy move; if it falls back, then this would just count as one big squeeze on a higher level. US-Venezuela oil cooperation stirs energy expectations

The United States and Venezuela have reached an agreement on oil resources, becoming a recent focus of international energy markets. According to Xinhua News Agency, U.S. President Donald Trump announced on social media that the U.S. had reached an accord with Venezuela, gaining “majority control” over more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela’s proven oil reserves. However, the same report also noted that Trump did not disclose the specific details of the agreement, and the White House has not yet released an official statement on the matter, meaning the public still needs to wait for a more complete legal text and implementation plan.

Venezuela has also confirmed the cooperation framework. Venezuela’s acting president, Delcy Rodríguez, said the country has reached a large-scale oil cooperation agreement with the United States. The deal allows private companies to participate to increase oil production. The relevant plan involves developing 17 strategic oil fields, with an investment of more than US$100 billion, and is expected to bring the Venezuelan government more than US$209 billion in tax revenue. The reform-related oil law she signed earlier also includes provisions allowing private and foreign investment in Venezuela’s oil industry.

At the factual level, the key change is not that crude oil has immediately entered the market, but rather that U.S. companies and other private capital may gain a deeper channel to participate in the development of Venezuela’s oil fields. There is a long chain linking oil reserves, development rights, production increases, and fiscal revenues, involving variables such as investment delivery, infrastructure repair, extraction costs, political arrangements, and the sanctions environment. Therefore, the actual impact of so-called “majority control” on the supply side still depends on the agreement’s details and its subsequent execution.

For the crypto market, the impact path mainly runs through macro expectation transmission. If the market believes that future crude oil supply will increase, energy price expectations may ease; inflation pressure and interest-rate expectations may change accordingly; and risk-asset sentiment could benefit. But if the agreement sparks geopolitical disputes or brings execution uncertainty, safe-haven sentiment may rise as well, and the risk appetite for assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum could be negatively affected by dollar liquidity and volatility in commodities.

The editorial assessment is that this event is worth watching, but it should not be interpreted directly as a definite signal for near-term energy prices or crypto asset trends. What has already been confirmed is the parties’ announcement of cooperation, as well as the oil fields, investment, and tax-revenue targets disclosed by the Venezuelan side. What has not yet been sufficiently verified are the agreement’s specific provisions, the boundaries of control, and the pace at which production capacity will be delivered. The more critical points to watch going forward are whether the White House or both sides publish formal documents, and whether private-sector investment truly moves into the execution stage.

#美获委内瑞拉石油田控制权 #BTC #ETH #BNB

content:
美委石油合作牵动能源预期

美国与委内瑞拉围绕石油资源达成合作，成为近期国际能源市场关注点。新华社报道称，美国总统特朗普在社交媒体宣布，美国已与委内瑞拉达成协议，获得对委内瑞拉已探明石油储量中逾650亿桶的“多数控制权”。但同一报道也指出，特朗普没有披露协议具体内容，白宫尚未就此发布正式消息，这意味着外界仍需等待更完整的法律文本和执行安排。

委内瑞拉方面也确认了合作框架。委内瑞拉代总统德尔西·罗德里格斯表示，该国同美国达成大规模石油合作协议，协议允许私营企业参与，以提高石油产量；相关计划涉及开发17个战略油田，投资额超过1000亿美元，并预计为委内瑞拉政府带来超过2090亿美元税收收入。她此前签署的石油法改革相关法案，也包含允许私人和外国投资委内瑞拉石油行业的内容。

从事实层面看，核心变化并不是原油已经立即进入市场，而是美国企业及其他私营资本可能获得更深度参与委内瑞拉油田开发的通道。石油储量、开发权、产量提升和财政收入之间存在较长链条，涉及投资落地、基础设施修复、开采成本、政治安排和制裁环境等变量。因此，所谓“多数控制权”对供应端的实际影响，仍取决于协议细节和后续执行。

对加密市场而言，影响路径主要通过宏观预期传导。若市场相信未来原油供给增加，能源价格预期可能缓和，通胀压力和利率预期随之变化，风险资产情绪可能受益；但若协议引发地缘政治争议或执行不确定性，避险情绪也可能上升，美元流动性和大宗商品波动会反向影响比特币、以太坊等资产的风险偏好。

编辑判断是，这一事件值得关注，但不宜直接解读为短期能源价格或加密资产走势的确定信号。当前已被证实的是双方宣布合作及委方披露的油田、投资和税收目标；尚未被充分证实的是协议细则、控制权边界和产能兑现节奏。后续更关键的观察点，是白宫或双方是否公布正式文件，以及私营企业投资是否真正进入执行阶段。

The fact is that both coin prices, volumes, and positions are increasing. Speculatively, BTC’s faster ramp-up in positions could be either confirmation of the trend—or it could mean the market is getting more crowded. ETH’s slower position build does not mean it’s safer; it only means its leverage participation works differently. What the market is confirming is whether this up-move can absorb newly added positions—not just whether there was a big bullish candle.

For the long thesis to hold: after the pullback, both coins’ prices stabilize, OI cools off, the funding rate isn’t getting too hot, and BTC’s position growth pace also stops running out of control. For the short thesis to hold: when price drops back, BTC OI remains high, ETH follows with accelerated position adding, and the funding rate rises; then leverage will amplify moves in the same direction.

The most common mistake traders make is to directly translate “price is up” and “positions are increasing” into “it’s safe.” OI only indicates that contract capital is increasing; it doesn’t say who will win. Once price can’t keep rewarding new positions, stop-losses, position reductions, and liquidations will turn the original push into pressure. When at least two of price, volume, open positions, and funding rate confirm each other, it’s worth paying more attention. When the data is inconsistent, waiting isn’t missing the move—it’s making room for invalid conditions.

My view: I care more about whether BTC’s position build speed will start to slow down first, and then whether ETH gets price follow-through. The position structure tells you where the risk is earlier than sentiment does.

Getting the trend right doesn’t mean getting the trade right.

title: 🏛️ SEC ACELERA CONVERGÊNCIA ENTRE WALL STREET E BLOCKCHAIN
subTitle:
A distância entre o mercado financeiro tradicional e o universo cripto pode começar a diminuir de forma mais estrutural nos Estados Unidos.
A SEC colocou em discussão duas frentes importantes: permitir que blockchains públicas sejam usadas como registro oficial de acionistas e detentores de valores mobiliários tokenizados e, ao mesmo tempo, estudar um mercado de ações americano funcionando 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana.
Nenhuma das duas mudanças está aprovada ainda. Mas o movimento já mostra que o regulador está começando a discutir infraestrutura que, até pouco tempo atrás, parecia exclusiva do mercado cripto.

🔗 BLOCKCHAIN COMO REGISTRO OFICIAL
A primeira proposta envolve os chamados transfer agents, agentes regulados responsáveis por manter o registro oficial de quem possui determinadas ações e outros valores mobiliários.
As regras atuais foram criadas para um mercado muito mais dependente de papel, sistemas fechados e processos tradicionais. A SEC quer modernizá-las para permitir que blockchains e outros livros-razão distribuídos possam servir como parte oficial desse registro.
Em termos simples: imagine o “livro do cartório” que comprova quem é dono de uma ação. Hoje ele fica dentro de sistemas tradicionais. A proposta abre espaço para que esse livro também exista onchain.
Isso não significa liberar qualquer token criado numa blockchain.
A responsabilidade continuaria com agentes de transferência registrados, responsáveis pelo chamado master securityholder file, além de obrigações de controle, gestão de risco, conservação de registros e reporte à SEC.
Ou seja: a blockchain poderia substituir parte da infraestrutura, mas não eliminaria o intermediário regulado.
A proposta ainda entra em consulta pública por 60 dias.
🪙 O QUE ISSO MUDA PARA ATIVOS TOKENIZADOS?
Se o modelo avançar, ações, obrigações e outros instrumentos tokenizados poderão ganhar um encaixe jurídico muito mais claro dentro do mercado americano.
Esse é um detalhe enorme.
Até hoje, muitos projetos de tokenização conseguem colocar um ativo “na blockchain”, mas o registro jurídico real continua fora dela.
A mudança permitiria aproximar os dois mundos: o token onchain e a titularidade legal do ativo poderiam passar a fazer parte da mesma infraestrutura regulatória.
É aí que a tokenização deixa de ser apenas representação digital e começa a se aproximar de infraestrutura financeira de verdade.
🕒 WALL STREET PODE COMEÇAR A NEGOCIAR 24/7?
A segunda frente talvez seja ainda mais fácil de visualizar.
A SEC convocou para 17 de setembro uma mesa-redonda pública sobre a possibilidade de ampliar a negociação de ações americanas para um modelo praticamente contínuo.
Entre os participantes estão nomes como BlackRock, Nasdaq, NYSE, Citadel Securities, Robinhood e DTCC.
A discussão envolve negociação durante a madrugada, liquidação contínua, compensação mais rápida e proteção ao investidor fora do horário tradicional.
Na prática, Wall Street está estudando algo que o Bitcoin já faz desde sempre: não fechar.
Hoje, se uma crise geopolítica acontece às três da manhã, o BTC reage imediatamente. Muitas ações precisam esperar a abertura do mercado regular para absorver completamente aquela informação.
Um mercado 24/7 mudaria essa dinâmica.

⚠️ MAS NÃO É TÃO SIMPLES
Negociar o tempo todo também traz riscos.
Durante a madrugada pode haver menos compradores e vendedores, o que significa menor liquidez e spreads maiores.
É como tentar vender um imóvel às três da manhã: talvez exista alguém interessado, mas provavelmente haverá menos participantes negociando preço.
Por isso a SEC também discute supervisão, clearing, liquidação instantânea e mecanismos de proteção.
🌉 E O QUE ISSO TEM A VER COM CRIPTO?
Praticamente tudo.
Se ações tokenizadas começarem a utilizar blockchain oficialmente e o mercado tradicional passar a operar 24/7, a fronteira entre “mercado cripto” e “mercado tradicional” começa a ficar muito menos clara.
Podemos caminhar para carteiras em que o investidor tenha, no mesmo ambiente:
Bitcoin, stablecoins, ações tokenizadas, ETFs, títulos, perpétuos onchain e outros ativos regulados.
A consequência também pode ser uma correlação maior entre os mercados. Notícias macroeconômicas poderiam atingir ações, Bitcoin e ativos tokenizados praticamente ao mesmo tempo, sem esperar a abertura de Nova York.
🔍 O QUE ACOMPANHAR AGORA
O ponto principal é não confundir discussão regulatória com aprovação.
A atualização dos transfer agents ainda está em consulta pública, e a reunião sobre negociação 24/7 é exploratória.
Mas a direção é relevante.
A SEC não está discutindo apenas “como regular cripto”. Está começando a discutir como levar características do mercado cripto para dentro do próprio sistema financeiro tradicional.

🔚 CONCLUSÃO
O movimento mais importante talvez não seja Wall Street entrar na blockchain.
É a blockchain começar a entrar na própria estrutura de Wall Street.
Se essas mudanças avançarem, ações poderão ser registradas onchain, mercados poderão funcionar sem fechar e a liquidação poderá se aproximar cada vez mais do modelo instantâneo que o setor cripto vem testando há anos.
Ainda não é uma revolução pronta.
Mas é um sinal claro de convergência: as finanças tradicionais estão começando a adotar a lógica operacional que nasceu no mercado cripto.
Conteúdo exclusivamente educativo e informativo. Não constitui recomendação de investimento.

The gap between traditional financial markets and the crypto universe may start to narrow in a more structural way in the United States.
The SEC has put two important fronts up for discussion: allowing public blockchains to be used as the official registry of shareholders and holders of tokenized securities, and at the same time studying a U.S. stock market operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Neither of the two changes has been approved yet. But the movement already shows that the regulator is starting to discuss infrastructure that, until recently, seemed exclusive to the crypto market.

Abraxas buys $39 million worth of ETH while holding a $291 million short position—what exactly are they betting on?

Abraxas Capital buys spot Ethereum for $39M, while simultaneously holding a $291M short position on Hyperliquid—an archetypal hedging/arbitrage posture.

On-chain data shows Abraxas Capital spent $39M to buy ETH spot, but their short exposure on Hyperliquid is as high as $291M—more than 7x their long exposure.

Simply put, this is the standard institutional playbook: take the spot premium on the spot side, then use perpetual/futures shorts to hedge away directional risk. What they make is the basis and funding rates, not a bet on whether price will go up or down. In short: this isn’t a bearish signal—it’s the footprint of a delta-neutral strategy.

Impact on the market
- Short term: ETH’s spot price is $2,450.98, up 2.01% over the past 24h. The market price hasn’t been dragged down by these $291M shorts, suggesting it’s already largely “priced in” for participants dealing with such positions. These large short positions, however, can also amplify volatility—if the market suddenly spikes upward, covering the shorts is fuel for further upside.
- Medium term: The fact that institutions are scaling up hedging on an on-chain platform like Hyperliquid indicates that derivatives liquidity is migrating from CEXs to on-chain venues. This trend is worth watching more than any single trade.

My take
A neutral event; it does not constitute a directional signal. ETH has spot bid support around $2,450.98. The zone $2,450.98–$2,550 overhead is a short-term resistance area. The direction in which this kind of delta-neutral position gets closed is often the trigger point for the market’s next move—worth monitoring, but you don’t have to follow. I’m 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% is left to the market. I’ll just observe with a small position—if I’m wrong, go easy on me.

Abraxas一边买3900万美元ETH，一边拿着2.91亿空单：到底在赌什么？

Abraxas Capital现货买入$39M以太坊，同时在Hyperliquid持有$291M空单，典型的对冲套利姿态。

链上数据显示，Abraxas Capital花3900万美元买入ETH现货，但他们在Hyperliquid上的空头仓位高达2.91亿美元，是多头敞口的7倍以上。

说白了这就是机构的标准玩法：现货吃现货溢价，合约做空对冲掉方向性风险，赚的是基差和资金费率，不是赌涨跌。简单说：这不是看空信号，是Delta中性策略的痕迹。

对市场的影响
- 短期：ETH现价$2,450.98，24h涨2.01%，价格本身没被这2.91亿空单砸下去，说明市场对这种仓位已经脱敏。这种大额空单反而会带来波动放大的可能——一旦行情急涨，空头平仓本身就是燃料。
- 中期：机构在Hyperliquid这种链上平台做大规模对冲，说明衍生品流动性正在从CEX向链上迁移，这个趋势比单笔仓位更值得关注。

我的判断
中性事件，不构成方向性信号。ETH在$2,450.98一线有现货买盘承接，上方$2,450.98-2,550是短期压力位。这种Delta中性仓位的平仓方向，往往才是后面行情的引爆点，值得盯但不用跟。这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场，我自己也就小仓位观察，说错轻喷。

Iran launched missiles at Kuwait. The Middle East conflict immediately spread to the doorstep of the Gulf oil-producing areas. In simple terms: the risk of a supply disruption has moved from “possible” to “being priced.” The probability of new oil-price highs is rising.

- Medium term: If the conflict continues and oil heads toward 100+, the stagflation trade will dominate. Valuations for risk assets will be compressed across the board, and expectations for the second-half market should be scaled down by one notch.

title: A Great Story Is Not the Same as a Great Investment.
subTitle:
Every crypto project has a story. Maybe it's building revolutionary technology. Maybe it promises mass adoption. Maybe it has a powerful community. Maybe influential people are talking about it. The story can be exciting. But before investing, ask: What evidence supports the story?" Look beyond the marketing.
🔹 Is the product actually being used?
🔹 Is the ecosystem growing?
🔹 Is there meaningful activity?
🔹 Does the token have a real purpose?
🔹 Is the development continuing?
🔹 Are the tokenomics sustainable?
🔹 What are the strongest arguments against the project?
A compelling narrative can attract attention. Evidence is what should build conviction.
🔑 Key Takeaway: Don't invest because the story sounds good. Investigate whether the facts support the story. The stronger the claim, the stronger the evidence you should demand.
🧠 Practical Reflection; When you discover your next promising project, write down:
THE STORY: What does the project say it will achieve? THE EVIDENCE: What can I independently verify today? Then ask: "Is my conviction based more on evidence or on the story I want to believe?"
Thought for the Day. Narratives create excitement. Evidence creates understanding. Understanding creates responsible conviction.
Systems over emotion. Conviction over noise.

#ETH Hey everyone! Last night around 3 a.m., a brother sent me a voice message—his voice was shaking!!

He said he opened positions with 10,000 U at 30x leverage; the orders dropped by less than 3% and he just blew up immediately. He asked me what exactly happened.

I told him: look at the records. When he saw he had only 9,500, he went all-in with the full position, and his stop-loss section was completely empty.

The truth is, a lot of people blow up right from the start because they get one thing backwards—not because your leverage is too high, but because your position size is too heavy.

Think about it: with 10,000 U as your principal, if you stuff 9,500 into a single position and the market so much as sneezes, you’re done.

But if you only use 1,000 U to open the trade, then price would need to move in the opposite direction by 50% to liquidate you. How can that be the same?

I personally went all-in for half a year and I never got liquidated. My account even trudged along and doubled. It’s not that I have some magical moves—just three hard-and-fast rules, nailed into my brain:

First: any single trade must never exceed 20% of your total funds. With a 10,000 U account, I enter at most 2,000 U per time. Even if I really misjudged it, and the stop-loss costs 10%, the loss would be only 200. Does it hurt? No—it’s just like hiring the market to have hot pot with you.

Second: single-trade losses are capped at dead-to-the-limit within 3% of total funds. Using 2,000 U as an example, I set the stop-loss in advance to 1.5%. That means a loss of 300, which lands right on the 3% line. If I make three or four mistakes, I can still stay calm and sit there watching the chart.

Third: in a ranging market, no matter how good it looks, I don’t reach out. No adding to positions just because I’m in profit—no adding, no adding, no adding. I only do trades where the trend clearly breaks out. If it’s just grinding sideways and looks enticing, I treat it as if I didn’t see it. After the order is placed, follow the rules—don’t haggle with your emotions.

All-in isn’t a tool to go gamble for your life. It’s to leave yourself a breath, and a chance to turn things around tomorrow.

The UK’s biggest retail trading platform has opened up BTC and ETH: this time, regulation is loosened—how much incremental capital could it bring?

The UK’s FCA has lifted the retail crypto ban. The UK’s largest retail investment platform, Hargreaves Lansdown, has quickly listed BTC and ETH ETNs.

The UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has lifted the ban on retail investors trading crypto ETNs (exchange-traded notes). Following that, Hargreaves Lansdown—Britain’s No. 1 retail investment platform—swiftly opened access to Bitcoin and Ethereum ETNs. Put simply: previously, UK retail investors wanted to touch these two products, but regulation directly said no. Now the door is open—millions of platform users can set up BTC and ETH exposure within accounts they already understand.

One-sentence translation: The UK version of a “compliance channel” has been opened, significantly reducing friction costs for retail capital to enter.

Impact on the market
- Short term: Positive for sentiment. BTC is currently at $77,903.53 (24h +1.53%), and ETH is at $2,406.11 (+1.13%). Regulatory easing is a typical “expectations get confirmed” bullish catalyst. In the near term, capital may flow in cautiously, but retail investors’ actual allocation pace in the UK is usually slow, so it likely won’t surge in a huge way immediately.
- Medium term: Another confirmation signal for the regulatory trend. After the US ETFs, major European markets are also gradually opening retail access. The more compliance channels there are, the bigger the pool of long-term incremental capital. The industry landscape may shift from “gray-area speculation” to “mainstream allocation.”

My take
Bullish, but expectations should be tempered. This BTC tailwind looks more like a medium-term thesis than a short-term catalyst. If it can hold above the $77,903 area, the next resistance could be aimed at the $80,000 psychological level. For ETH, if it breaks out with volume above $2,450, the upside elasticity could be stronger. The risk is that UK retail investors are sensitive to ETN fees, so actual inflows may be lower than the market’s “massive capital” fantasies. 【ETH dropped 51%, what are institutions and retail investors doing?】

To be honest, since ETH fell 51% from its peak, I now view it from a different angle than most people.

A couple of days ago I saw a news piece: Standard Chartered Bank has launched spot BTC and ETH trading in the UAE. Honestly, my first reaction wasn’t “good news,” but—what are these institutions doing? Why choose this moment to expand into emerging markets?

It’s very simple. A 51% retracement zone, historically, is always an area where big capital starts building positions. Big money doesn’t chase pumps; they wait for precisely this kind of level. Did ETF outflows hit 48 million? Retail is running, institutions are stepping in—I’ve seen this pattern too many times.

But that’s not the main point. The key is: what does it mean when this actually happens in practice?

If you already have positions, the question you should sort out now isn’t “Will it keep dropping?” but “Why should I hold it?” ETH’s fundamentals haven’t changed. There are more and more ETF players, and the RWA narrative is still running. At this level, the number of people willing to build positions is far greater than it was three months ago.

What about China? To be honest, the situation in China’s A-share market is a bit like the crypto world right now—all waiting for signals. When domestic policy direction and macro data turning points land, regardless of which market it is, capital will move.

I’m not saying “buy now.” I just want to ask you: at this ETH level, are you truly thinking about its value—or are you only staring at that number?

content:
【ETH跌了51%，机构和散户在干什么】

老实说，ETH从高位跌了51%，我现在看它的角度跟大多数人不一样。

前两天看到一条新闻：渣打银行在阿联酋推出BTC和ETH现货交易。说实话，我第一反应不是"利好"，而是——这些机构在干什么？为什么偏偏选这个时候在新兴市场布局？

道理很简单。51%的回撤区，从历史上看，从来都是大资金开始建仓的区域。大资金不追涨，他们等的就是这种位置。ETF流出了48 million？散户在跑，机构在进，这事我见过太多次了。

但这不是重点。重点是：这件事落到实处意味着什么？

你要是手里有仓位，现在最该想清楚的不是"还会不会跌"，而是"我凭什么拿着它"。ETH的基本面没变，ETF玩家越来越多，RWA叙事还在跑。跌到这个位置，愿意建仓的人比三个月前多得多。

那中国这边呢？说实话，A股现在的情况跟加密圈有点像——都在等信号。国内政策的风向，宏观数据的拐点，这些东西落地了，不管是哪个市场，资金都会动起来。

我不是在说"赶紧买"，我只是想问你：你现在对ETH这个位置，是真的在思考它的价值，还是只是在盯着那个数字看？

Strive要把BTC囤到27000枚以上：小公司凭什么学MicroStrategy？

Strive CEO Matt Cole暗示年底持仓或超27000枚BTC，企业囤币队伍再添一员。

Strive这家公司大家可能不熟，但玩法很激进：CEO Matt Cole公开暗示，年底前公司比特币持仓可能会突破27000枚。这是什么概念？按BTC现价$77,973.72算，光币就值约210亿美元，再加上杠杆和结构化操作，规模不小。说白了就是MicroStrategy剧本的复刻版——用资本市场融资，换成BTC，把资产负债表变成比特币敞口。

一句话翻译：又一家上市公司决定把自己变成“比特币杠杆基金”。

对市场的影响
- 短期：情绪面利多。BTC现在$77,973.72，24h涨1.70%，这种消息给现货添了一把火。企业持续买入意味着链外资金持续进场，抛压被吃掉一部分。

Put plainly, this move wasn’t unexpected. Standard Chartered has already started digital asset custody in the UAE in 2024, and in July 2025 it set up an institutional spot trading desk at its UK branch first—now it’s simply been brought that same capability to the Gulf.

With a G-SIB stepping in directly, the signal carries more weight than a single bank testing the waters on its own. Once this kind of bank makes a move, institutional clients don’t have to set up a dedicated crypto account or connect to a stack of native platforms just to get started. Trading, custody, and settlement can all be completed within the same familiar interface, and the compliance pathway is clear as well. For large capital that has been hesitating over-the-counter, it’s effectively like another turn of the door handle has been made.

In the UAE, the regulatory framework is already in place, with custody, stablecoins, and tokenization all being pushed forward. Standard Chartered fills in the “execution” piece, and the whole chain is now complete. The next thing to watch is whether other global banks follow suit.

Why did the SEC approve Bitcoin ETF options too? WisdomTree just got the green light

The SEC has approved options trading on the WisdomTree Bitcoin Fund, giving institutional hedging tools another big boost—directly positive for BTC.

The SEC officially approved options trading for the WisdomTree Bitcoin Fund (BTCW). In plain terms: institutions that hold this Bitcoin ETF can now buy and sell its call and put options directly in the U.S. stock market.

Why does this matter? After IBIT’s options were approved last year, they quickly sparked large-scale covered calls and structured products from institutions. Now WisdomTree has also gotten the ticket in. This suggests the SEC has turned “Bitcoin ETF + options” into a routine approval pathway, rather than handling it on a case-by-case basis.

One-sentence translation: Previously, institutions could only go long BTC outright. Now they can use options to hedge, earn option premiums, and build structured products—so institutional money can come in with fewer worries.

Market impact
The transmission path is very straightforward: options approval → institutions can hedge → stronger positioning appetite → ETF inflows → direct support for BTC’s price.

- Short term: sentiment tailwind. It also lines up with today’s broad market rally (BTC 24h +5.28% to $81,438.01). In terms of themes, this adds some heat
- Medium term: another piece in the trend of loosening regulation. The more tools available, the more controllable Wall Street’s cost and risk of allocating to BTC becomes, and the friction cost for long-term capital to enter declines systemically.

My take
The bullish direction is clear, but let’s be precise: this is a medium-term positive—not a catalyst for a pump tonight. BTC is currently $81,438.01. First, we need to see whether it can hold above $82K. If it holds, the rebound has a chance to continue. If it breaks below $79K, that means this wave of sentiment has already been fully digested.

Block, a payments company owned by Dorsey, disclosed that its BTC holdings have unrealized gains of $433 million. Pay attention to the key word: unrealized—meaning paper gains, not sold. Over the years, Dorsey has repeatedly converted a portion of the company’s profits into BTC. As the coin price rose, the financial statements benefited directly.

In one sentence: A payments company’s money made by hoarding coins could look even more impressive than some quarters’ profits from its core business—and it never planned to sell.

If more fintech companies find that hoarding BTC can improve their financial statements, then demand won’t be just scattered retail-style buying, but corporate treasury cash flows in a full-on, systematic way. On this path, MSTR set the example first; Block followed; and later entrants will do the math.

Bullish, with a clear direction. The unrealized gains at Block essentially come from supply-side tightness: hoarding coins without selling. - Short term: If the DXY continues trending down, BTC may be able to hold the $105.23K psychological level and look for resistance near the previous highs. Marathon is still hoarding after halving August production; the treasury has grown to 25,000 BTC, which is bullish for the supply side by locking in liquidity.

What’s going on
Marathon (MARA) reported August production of 670 BTC—clearly down month-over-month. Last month was still over 800 BTC. The main reason for the cut is difficulty increases and competition for hashrate. But the real focus is that their treasury reserves have piled up to 25,000 BTC. That makes them one of the biggest BTC hoarders among U.S.-listed companies, second only to MicroStrategy.

One-sentence translation: The more they mine, the less they produce, but the coins they do mine are all locked up and not sold—meaning they’re effectively pulling liquidity out of the market every day.

Market impact
